rows.q: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
rows.answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per month. [1]

rows.q: How many unused leave days can be carried over?
rows.answer: Up to 6 unused days can be carried over into the next year; any balance above 6 days lapses on 31 March. [1]

rows.q: How quickly must on-call acknowledge a SEV1 page?
rows.answer: A SEV1 incident requires the on-call engineer to acknowledge the page within 10 minutes and post a status update every 30 minutes until resolved. [1]

rows.q: What is the home-office allowance for new employees?
rows.answer: Each new employee receives a laptop and a one-time home-office allowance of INR 25,000. [1]
